title: Ranked - Beta Season 2
headline: Ranked Beta Season 2 resets ranks, cuts loss shields, and adds a fourth ban.

reset_steps.title: Redistribute the curve
reset_steps.detail: The whole rank curve is reshaped first to absorb the influx of new players, so some ranks rise before any reset.

reset_steps.title: Apply the soft reset
reset_steps.detail: The redistributed number then drops about 1 badge on average, nudged 1-2 subranks by last season's winrate.

reset_steps.title: Skip calibration
reset_steps.detail: Existing Ranked players keep their standing and climb directly; only players who sat out Season 1 recalibrate.

rules.label: Shields at Phantom and up
rules.note: Full ranks and subranks both lose all protection.

rules.label: Shields at a full rank
rules.note: Mystic I at 0 points falls to Sentinel after 3 losses.

rules.label: Shields between subranks
rules.note: Mystic III to Mystic II now survives only one loss.

rules.label: Points per match
rules.note: Every game moves the bar further.

rules.label: Points to reach a new badge
Hero bans per match
rules.note: Draft gets a fourth slot to target top heroes.

rules.label: Highest initial placement
rules.note: Up to Ascendant III for strong previous-season performance.

rules.label: Hero unlock requirement
rules.note: 2 per win, 1 per loss; the old system equalled about 45 points.

rules.label: Season-scoped leaderboards
rules.note: Hero boards need 15 matches with that hero in 30 days.

winners.why: 350 points per game plus 1500-point promotions reward volume over a lucky streak.
Global redistribution runs before the soft reset, so part of the ladder moves up not down.
35 points versus an equivalent 45 means losses now count toward unlocking.

losers.why: Their full loss protection is deleted outright, so a bad streak now costs real ranks.
Shields of 3 and 1 leave far less room to absorb a losing run at a floor.
A fourth ban gives opponents more room to remove their hero from the draft.
